As with preexisting diabetes, those women with GDM 
should be followed carefully during pregnancy and managed by 
a diabetes team that includes a CDE. See Chapter 30 for diet 
and exercise recommendations, including target glucose values. 
Medications may be necessary to manage blood sugars; insulin 
and some oral hypoglycemic agents (e.g., metformin and gly-
buride) can be used. Long-term use of metformin is associated 
with decreased vitamin B12 levels, but its use only in late preg-
nancy has not been shown to be problematic for maintenance 
of normal B12 levels (Gatford et al, 2013).
Women with GDM should be screened for persistent diabe-
